2607.13753.title: Post-Training Shifts Confidence: A Three-Stage Analysis of How SFT, RL, and OPD Shape Pre-, Intra-, and Post-CoT Calibration
2607.13753.paper_summary: Large language models have made strong reasoning gains through supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation, yet these post-training methods are usually evaluated only by final-answer accuracy. We study how they reshape confidence during reasoning. We introduce a three-stage calibration framework that evaluates confidence before, during, and after chain-of-thought generation, corresponding to difficulty estimation, early termination, and answer aggregation. Through a controlled comparison on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, we find that OPD provides the most useful pre-reasoning confidence, SFT gives the strongest online signal for early stopping, and RL produces the most reliable trace-level signal for aggregation. We further show that confidence reliability is position-dependent: RL confidence becomes informative after a path-commitment phase, while OPD confidence is useful early but can become inversely calibrated later. Based on this observation, we propose PosConf, a position-aware confidence strategy that uses confidence only from reliable relative-position intervals. PosConf improves RL answer aggregation by 6.1 points over majority voting and consistently improves OPD early stopping under tight token budgets, with gains up to 4.3 points by avoiding its later inverse-calibration region, showing that \emph{confidence in reasoning models should be used both stage-wise and position-awarely}. Our code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Post-Training-Calibration.
2607.13753.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型透過監督微調、強化學習和策略蒸餾在推理方面取得了顯著的進展，然而這些訓練後的方法通常僅通過最終答案的準確性來評估。我們研究它們在推理過程中如何重塑信心。我們引入了一個三階段的校準框架，評估在思考鏈生成之前、期間和之後的信心，對應於難度估計、早期終止和答案聚合。通過對數學推理基準的控制比較，我們發現 OPD 提供了最有用的推理前信心，SFT 提供了最強的在線信號以進行早期停止，而 RL 產生了最可靠的追蹤級信號以進行聚合。我們進一步顯示信心的可靠性是位置依賴的：RL 信心在路徑承諾階段後變得信息豐富，而 OPD 信心在早期有用，但後來可能會變得反向校準。基於這一觀察，我們提出了 PosConf，一種位置感知的信心策略，僅使用來自可靠相對位置區間的信心。PosConf 在大多數投票中提高了 RL 答案聚合 6.1 分，並在緊湊的標記預算下持續改善 OPD 的早期停止，通過避免其後期的反向校準區域，獲得高達 4.3 分的增益，顯示出 \emph{推理模型中的信心應該同時以階段性和位置感知的方式使用}。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/EIT-NLP/Post-Training-Calibration 獲得。
